title: Charisma vs. Revelation: Don't Confuse Emotion with Truth #shorts

top_liked.text: The confidence and charisma are the hook that brings vulnerable people a type of mental security, something unreal that moves from storytelling to eternal truth. It's a racket. Preying on the weak
